# Postil

Postil is an AI pull-request reviewer for GitHub repositories. It focuses on correctness, security, infrastructure risk, and repeated failure patterns.

## Website

- Home: https://postil.dev/
- Pricing: https://postil.dev/#pricing

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/postil-dev/postil

## Notes for language models

Postil leaves focused inline findings and avoids style-only comments.
